% A document with titletoc's partial table of contents, beside the .ptc
% and .aux of an earlier build, and its own files named like it, which
% are not lists: its class, the class's option file, which the class
% reads, tex4ht's configuration file for the class and package, its
% package, files read with \input under the extensions .def, .ltx, .fd,
% .bbx, and .cbx, a text file, its bibliography database, and its
% bibliography style, and a Fortran source under the extension .F90, a
% letter and digits like minitoc's numbered lists under its shortext
% option, read with \input, with no command. Each line of the TeX files
% and the text file starts with a command and a space, as in a list that
% \write gives, so only their extensions keep them from being hidden.
% The .aux names the .ptc, which holds titletoc's \ttl@starttoc and an
% \addtocontents write of \oldmark, which this document does not define.
% A .S1, named like a list of minitoc's shortext option, holds only lines
% of a command and a space, with no \mtc@string: it is hidden as a list,
% and the log names no file of minitoc's, as this document has no minitoc.
% The stale files and the document's own files stay as they are.
